scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.bun:install: bun install --cwd frontend && bun install --cwd backend
scripts.bun:test: bun run --cwd backend test && bun run --cwd frontend test
scripts.bun:build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
